mapper.select: SELECT attendanceid, branchid, memberid, method, regdate FROM ttokssaemdb.attendance WHERE regdate > STR_TO_DATE(#{lastdate}, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') AND memberid = #{memberid} AND ( method = 0 OR method = 1 ) ORDER BY regdate DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ttokssaemdb.attendance ( branchid, memberid, method, regdate ) VALUES ( #{branchid}, #{memberid}, #{method}, now() )
